What it is: Burn-rate meter and cost sidecar double-count master-resident roles instead of reporting them as combined/unattributed
What it solves: CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE (verified against source, not just the intake's
hypothesis): `computeBurnRateForRoles` (`extension/src/metrics/
burnRate.ts:50`) and the equivalent BL-272 cost-sidecar path
(`extension/src/metrics/costTelemetry.ts:132`) both call the shared
`readTranscriptUsage(role.worktreePat…
How it works: Two roles sharing the same worktreePath are reported as one combined/shared usage total, not two independent identical totals
